summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (bun v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` (727,680 bytes) shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (Bun-bundled with a string-array rotation decoder, `_0x......` identifier scheme, mixed numeric/string decoder table). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js use the same obfuscator naming pattern. The package's declared purpose is a verdaccio storage plugin, which has no need for a Bun runtime; the payload is delivered specifically to an alternate runtime so it is not loaded or inspected by Node. The package name `verdaccio-tarball-local-storage` and description ("Cropped and fixed version of the @verdaccio/local-storage plugin") mimic the well-known `@verdaccio/local-storage` plugin, positioning the tarball to be pulled into developer environments expecting the official plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
